title: Lightly Grilled Filipino Pork Sisig
description: A fresh and tender Filipino dish featuring pork, sesame seed oil, and a deglaze-fond, perfect for a date-night dinner. This Whole30-friendly recipe is a twist on the classic sisig.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together sesame seed oil, lime juice, fish sauce, chili peppers, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame seed oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced pork to the skillet and stir to combine with the oil.
Deglaze the skillet with 1 tablespoon of lime juice, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with minced onion and chili peppers.
